harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `inventory-worker` on node1 as a persistent SysV service. It runs as dedicated account `inventorysvc` inside a root-owned chroot, with `/var/lib/inventory` as its sole writable directory. CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18 were preserved. Reboot persistence and recovery were verified.
actions_performed: Created the unprivileged system account `inventorysvc` (UID 101, GID 102, nologin shell).
Created a minimal root-owned chroot at `/srv/inventory-chroot`.
Installed a heartbeat-based background worker and root-owned SysV init service named `inventory-worker`.
Configured the launcher to enter the chroot, clear supplementary groups, and drop to UID 101/GID 102.
Verified filesystem confinement with direct permitted and denied write probes.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified a changed boot identity, automatic service recovery, advancing heartbeat data, and preserved confinement.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Before and after configuration/reboot, node1 reports CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

evidence.requirement: Background worker is managed as `inventory-worker` under dedicated unprivileged account `inventorysvc`
evidence.summary: The dedicated account exists, the SysV service is enabled, and the running process has UID 101, GID 102, and no supplementary groups.

evidence.requirement: Worker filesystem view is confined to a root-owned chroot
evidence.summary: The process root resolves to `/srv/inventory-chroot`, whose ownership and mode are root:root 0755; service and worker code are also root-owned.

evidence.requirement: `/var/lib/inventory` is the only writable application directory
evidence.summary: Direct service-identity probes denied writes to `/`, `/etc`, and the worker-code directory while permitting `/var/lib/inventory`; the directory scan found only that directory writable by the service identity.

evidence.requirement: Worker is healthy and produces data
evidence.summary: Service status is running and heartbeat timestamps advance before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID `0f320dc5-3a9a-4350-8000-000000000000`; reboot was acknowledged; the recovered node reports changed boot ID `bbae9217-f2f1-4208-8000-000000000000`; post-reboot service, identity, chroot, enablement, and advancing heartbeat were directly verified.
